comment: Dr Peters goes above and beyond to meet you where you are. Had a lot of scheduling conflicts this semester, and he went out of his way to make accommodate . He also is so intentional about what he's teaching you and focuses on making sure you genuinely understand not only the content, but why/how it'll serve you in postgrad life.

Dr. Peters is so nice and fair to his students. He is super into experiential learning and makes class more interactive than a lot of other bio professors. Super kind and will help you outside of class. BIO 200 can be hard but I would take it with him

Dr. Peters was my favorite professor this year. His lectures are a mix of lecture and activities and I actually felt like I understood the material. Not much homework and the exams are hard but fair. I would definitely recommend his class.

Dr. Peters is probably the best bio teacher ever. He focuses on application, never tests you on things he didn't go over, and gives a topic list for every test. He sets you up to get an A in his class and wants you to succeed. He is funny, intelligent, and class is always fun. DO TAKE HIS CLASS! You won't regret it.

Dr. Peters is a fantastic addition to the UR biology staff. He's very intelligent, an engaging lecturer, a dedicated professor who is always available for help, and genuinely cares for his students. The material requires attention and effort but isn't overwhelming and gives a really great view into neurodegenerative disease and associated drugs.
